newsitem.title: USA: Dow falls 50 points, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow falls 50 points, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks steepened their losses in mid-afternoon, triggering program-trading curbs on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Dow industrials was down 53 points to 6651, with declining issues extending their advantage over gainers to a nearly two-to-one margin on NYSE volume of about 290 million shares.
The NYSE imposed index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1430 EDT/1830 GMT.

Program trading contributed to the decline in the blue chip average. Birinyi Associates said it was tracking a sell program on the New York Stock Exchange but could not provide details because the program was still in progress.
